answer: Grades are sealed when submitted and only opened at close, so graders cannot react to or copy each other, which prevents a Sybil cluster from coordinating its votes within a single jury. The effect is that voting power tracks real contribution, so a flood of accounts cannot outvote a smaller set of genuinely established participants.. The effect holds because jury selection is secret and random, so an attacker can never target the specific identities that will judge it. Consider a terrace as the anchor of the cost. A vine stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a thread holds...
